Order is not guaranteed. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of selected node IDs, empty if no nodes selected. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Query current selection: ::: {#2d3e4f9b .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_star_graph(5) .select_nodes_by_degree(min_degree=3) ) selected = graph.get_selected_node_ids() # Returns 1 (the center node) len(selected) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 1 ``` ::: :::
